name: 10 pips
summary: This is a scalping EA that aims for small pip targets (10 pips) per trade. It opens positions based on short-term momentum signals and closes them quickly once the modest take-profit is reached, relying on high win-rate frequency to accumulate profits.
summary_zh: 这是一个剥头皮EA，每笔交易目标仅为10点利润。它基于短期动量信号开仓，并在达到 modest 止盈目标后迅速平仓，依靠高胜率频繁交易来积累利润。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是典型的剥头皮交易，追求每笔交易仅10点的微小利润，通过高频交易积累收益。入场条件基于短期动量或价格突破，在价格出现短暂方向性移动时快速进场。出场条件采用固定止盈（10点）和止损的组合，止盈距离非常小，期望通过高胜率弥补风险。仓位管理方面，代码中可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的简单仓位计算，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理较为简单，未发现复杂的资金曲线调整或风险比例控制逻辑，存在连续亏损时风险放大的隐患。整体策略依赖市场在短时间内的微小波动，在低流动性和高点差环境下表现可能不佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is classic scalping, targeting a mere 10 pips per trade and accumulating profits through high-frequency trading. Entry conditions are based on short-term momentum or brief price breakouts, quickly entering when a directional move is detected. Exit conditions use a fixed take-profit (10 pips) paired with a stop-loss, with the very small TP distance relying on a high win rate to offset losses. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or a simple account-balance ratio without dynamic adjustment. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking equity curve adjustments or proportional risk control, which poses a risk of amplified drawdown during consecutive losses. The overall strategy depends on capturing micro price movements and may underperform in low-liquidity or high-spread environments.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调整参数
固定小目标止盈在高波动市场容易快速成交
剥头皮策略在趋势明确时胜率较高
代码结构简单，适合初学者学习EA开发
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Fixed small TP target is easily hit in volatile markets for quick exits
Scalping strategy can achieve high win rates during clear directional moves
Straightforward code structure suitable for beginners learning EA development
cons: 10点止盈在很多货币对上甚至不够覆盖点差成本
缺乏点差过滤，高点差时段交易会严重侵蚀利润
未发现新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线重复开仓
仓位管理缺乏动态调整，无法根据市场波动自适应
剥头皮策略对经纪商执行质量高度敏感，滑点影响大
cons_en: 10-pip TP is often insufficient to cover spread costs on many currency pairs
No spread filter means trading during high-spread periods severely erodes profit
No new bar check detected, risk of repeated entries on the same bar
Position sizing lacks dynamic adjustment and cannot adapt to market volatility
Scalping is highly sensitive to broker execution quality; slippage impact is significant
improvements: 添加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时禁止开仓
增加新K线检查，防止同一根K线重复进场
引入ATR动态调整止盈止损距离，适应市场波动变化
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to prohibit trading when spread exceeds a threshold
Implement new bar checking to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle
Introduce ATR-based dynamic TP/SL to adapt to changing market volatility

risk_points: 剥头皮策略缺乏点差过滤，高点差环境下可能持续亏损
固定小止盈目标在市场噪音中容易被触发但利润微薄
未检测到新K线检查，存在同一根K线重复开仓的风险
risk_points_en: Scalping without spread filter can lead to consistent losses during high-spread periods
Fixed small TP target is easily triggered by market noise but yields minimal profit
No new bar check detected, risk of duplicate entries on the same candle
